title: Energy-Aware HPC Scheduling with LLM-Based Power Prediction
problem: HPC energy consumption strains grid; need operational strategies to manage HPC as grid load
motivation: Theoretical energy-aware scheduling studied; lack practical implementations; grid integration critical
method: LLM-based per-job power prediction; lightweight scheduling strategy; Slurm integration without core mods
key_novelty: LLM embeddings for power prediction; 15% MAE improvement; 4.0 MWh solar shift without throughput loss
contributions: LLM-based power prediction from job scripts
Energy-aware scheduling without Slurm core modification
Per-job power MAE reduction (15% vs SOTA)
